name: kyuz0 Strix Halo 8060S GLM-4.7-Flash-UD-Q8_K_XL ROCm 7.2.3 64k tg32
methodology: kyuz0 amd-strix-halo-toolboxes llama-bench sweep (results.json generated 2026-05-18, Fedora 43 kernel 6.19.12-200, llama.cpp build 0253fb21f / b9187). ROCm 7.2.3, -fa 1 -ngl 99 --mmap 0. notes: Not in the earlier kyuz0 filing, which covered only the default-context pp512/tg128 cells. Same results.json, the longctx32768 and longctx65536 rows.
